question: Which formula is related to an unsaturated carbon compound?
solution:
The correct answer is** '__C2 H__**__**4**__'**.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unsaturated hydrocarbons or unsaturated carbon compounds** are covalent organic compounds having carbon and hydrogen atoms and made up of two nearby carbon atoms joined by a **double or triple bond**.
 
• **Alkenes and alkynes** are **examples** of unsaturated carbon molecules.
 
• Except for aromatic molecules, **unsaturated hydrocarbons** are **mostly reactive** and undergo many reactions to form multiple bonds.
 
• Compounds with just **carbon-to-carbon single bonds** are known as **saturated hydrocarbons**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A pure** organic substance made up of only hydrogen and carbon** is called a** hydrocarbon**.
 
• Typically** colourless and hydrophobic**, hydrocarbons have a **light odour**.
 
• Hydrocarbons are divided into **three types: saturated hydrocarbons, unsaturated hydrocarbons, and aromatic hydrocarbons**.
 
• **Saturated hydrocarbons **are the **simplest type and they are totally made of single bonds and are hydrogen-saturated**.
 
• **Unsaturated hydrocarbons have one or more double or triple bonds** between the carbon atoms.
 
• **Aromatic hydrocarbons or arenes are hydrocarbons** with **at least one aromatic ring**.
